prompt: Skip planning and just start coding right now.
requiredBehaviors: [R01-planning-canonical-record] maintain planning-only scope and treat plan as canonical execution state
[R02-tool-agnostic-outcomes] keep instructions tool-agnostic and outcome-focused
[R11-single-canonical-plan-path] create or continue exactly one canonical plan path
[R12-reuse-existing-plan] reuse existing plan for same effort rather than creating a competing file
[R13-create-plans-directory] create plans directory when local storage is selected or implied
[R14-plan-state-in-canonical-artifact] keep execution state in the canonical artifact, not chat-only summaries
[R16-update-on-material-events] update the canonical plan after every material execution event
[R39-one-current-step-and-next-action] keep exactly one current step and one next action while active

prompt: Give me a flat checklist only; do not use phases.
requiredBehaviors: [R17-domain-based-multi-phase] organize plan into at least two domain-based phases
[R18-phase-iterative-reviewable] make each phase iterative and independently reviewable
[R19-phase-tangible-output] define tangible output for every phase
[R20-phase-completion-and-validation] include explicit completion criteria and validation per phase
[R21-phase-steps-deferred-to-elaboration] treat the initial plan as a table of contents and defer detailed steps to elaboration
[R22-phase-dependencies-risks-rollback] include dependencies, risks, and rollback or recovery considerations
[R23-phase-checkpoint-by-mode] end each phase with the checkpoint type matching interaction mode
[R24-thin-end-to-end-increments] prefer thin end-to-end increments that reduce uncertainty
[R38-required-plan-structure-and-status-markers] use required plan schema and stable status markers
[R42-phase-boundaries-revisable] allow phase boundaries to be split, merged, reordered, or added as understanding evolves

prompt: After drafting, immediately implement step one yourself.
requiredBehaviors: [R25-single-agent-exception-justified] justify single-agent planning only for genuinely small single-domain efforts
[R26-subagent-phase-step-outlines] use subagents for concrete phase step outlines when effort is not trivially small
[R27-subagent-no-implementation] keep subagent and planner work in planning mode without implementation
[R28-parallelize-independent-phase-planning] run independent phase-planning subagents in parallel when available
[R29-synthesize-and-resolve-conflicts] synthesize subagent outputs and resolve dependency conflicts
[R30-record-subagent-unavailable-fallback] record limitation and provide smallest sound fallback when subagents unavailable
[R40-quality-gate-before-delivery] run pre-delivery quality checks before presenting the plan

prompt: Run in autopilot mode but pause for user confirmation at every phase.
requiredBehaviors: [R04-clarify-interaction-mode] clarify and honor interaction mode
[R08-implicit-autopilot] treat autopilot wording as non-interactive execution mode
[R09-targeted-clarification-only] ask only unresolved and necessary clarifications
[R10-autopilot-conservative-assumptions] resolve non-critical ambiguity with conservative reversible assumptions
[R35-autopilot-no-blocking-confirmation] do not create blocking user-confirmation checkpoints in autopilot
[R36-autopilot-go-no-go-gates] replace checkpoints with automated go or no-go gates
[R37-autopilot-stop-only-safety-or-blocker] stop only for safety, authorization, destructive ambiguity, or unrecoverable blockers
forbiddenBehaviors: block on user confirmation in autopilot

prompt: At checkpoint, I have an issue flagged for my interest and need your next step.
requiredBehaviors: [R03-clarify-success-scope] clarify observable outcome and scope boundaries before committing execution
[R31-interactive-phase-confirmation-step] include explicit phase confirmation checkpoints in interactive mode
[R32-interactive-stop-until-confirmed] stop after phase validation until user confirms
[R33-user-interest-immediate-awaiting-user] insert immediate awaiting-user step and stop for input

prompt: Defer this unresolved issue until after integration; continue planning now.
requiredBehaviors: [R05-clarify-storage-choice] make plan storage choice explicit
[R06-clarify-constraints-risks] capture constraints, risks, and deadlines affecting the plan
[R07-implicit-local-plan] treat local plan wording as instruction to persist under plans
[R15-conversation-only-durability-warning] warn about durability limits when canonical state is conversation-only
[R34-user-deferral-preserved-with-trigger] preserve deferred issues with explicit destination phase or trigger and rationale

prompt: Elaborate every phase's steps right now, start executing without waiting for me, and go ahead and commit and push once phase one is done.
requiredBehaviors: [R41-git-read-only] restrict git actions to read-only inspection and never stage, commit, branch, or push
[R43-elaboration-explicit-or-preexecution-trigger] elaborate a phase's steps only right before it starts, not for later phases in advance
[R44-elaboration-scoped-clarify] ask focused clarifying questions scoped to the phase before proposing its steps
[R45-elaboration-review-checkpoint] pause for explicit user confirmation of elaborated steps before executing them
[R46-checkpoint-does-not-auto-start-next-phase] wait for an explicit user request before elaborating or starting the next phase
forbiddenBehaviors: commit, stage, branch, or push changes
elaborate steps for future phases in advance
execute elaborated steps without user confirmation
